adminLicence.stepupDescription: Enter your authenticator code to approve {{type}}.
adminLicence.clocksDetail: Provisional credit within 10 business days, final answer within 45 days (90 for new accounts or cross-border).
adminLicence.cashoutDisputesDetail: Acknowledge within 10 business days and answer within 45 days.
adminLicence.resolutionHelp: Explain the outcome. The customer sees this text.
adminLicence.disclosuresDetail: Counsel-approved text is published per language with the oversight action credit_disclosure_publish.
adminLicence.placeholderDisclosures: No approved text yet. Customers see the built-in wording.
adminLicence.wageRequired: Consent is required before wages are paid in Credit.
adminLicence.wageOptional: Consent is recorded but not yet enforced (OXSTEED_CREDIT_WAGE_CONSENT_REQUIRED is off).
adminLicence.holidaysDetail: Used to count business days. Change them with credit_business_holiday_set.
adminLicence.bankDetail: Export a batch for the bank, then two different administrators confirm each instruction.
adminLicence.confirmHelp: Bank reference (optional). A second administrator must give the same answer.
adminLicence.heldDetail: Release needs two administrators. Rejecting returns the money to the helper.
adminLicence.dormancyDisabled: The dormancy sweep is off. Set a policy per country first.
adminLicence.policiesDetail: Set with credit_dormancy_policy_set from the law of each country.
adminLicence.reclaimHelp: How was the owner's identity checked?
adminLicence.remitHelp: Reference from the authority for {{count}} selected cases.
adminLicence.reviewsDetail: Each quarter, every admin role, grant and API key is kept or revoked by someone other than its holder.
adminLicence.revokeHelp: Say why this access should be removed.
adminLicence.packsDetail: Each pack has a SHA-256 over its files. Every download is audited.
adminLicence.anchorsDetail: The head of every audit hash chain is anchored outside the database each day and checked against it.
adminLicence.windDownDetail: Every step needs two administrators. Holders are notified and paid to their verified bank accounts.
adminLicence.windDownStartHelp: Give at least 30 days' notice. This freezes new Credit activity.
adminLicence.windDownStartConfirm: Request a wind-down with a redemption deadline of {{date}}?
adminLicence.windDownCancelHelp: Say why the wind-down is cancelled.
adminLicence.redeemableDetail: Everything owed to customers and helpers, by currency.
adminLicence.sourcesStale: {{count}} required lists are out of date. Screening fails closed.
adminLicence.sourcesFresh: All required lists are up to date.
adminLicence.customDetail: Additions and removals need two administrators.
adminLicence.safeguardingDetail: Customer money held in segregated accounts, reconciled daily against what we owe.
adminLicence.noSafeguardingAccounts: No safeguarding account yet. Add one with credit_safeguarding_account_add.
adminLicence.kycDetail: Raised by limits and AML rules. Waivers need two administrators.
adminLicence.waiveHelp: Why can this check be waived?
adminLicence.sarDetail: Draft, submit, approve (second administrator), then file with the regulator.
adminLicence.caseIdsHelp: Compliance case IDs, separated by commas.
adminLicence.narrativeHelp: Describe the activity and why it is suspicious.
adminLicence.fxDetail: HTG uses the BRH reference rate. A stale rate blocks conversion.
adminLicence.limitsDetail: Stored as data. Change them with credit_limit_rule_update.

actionTypes.credit_business_holiday_set: Set or remove a bank holiday
actionTypes.credit_escheat_execute: Move a dormant balance to unclaimed property
actionTypes.credit_escheat_reclaim: Return unclaimed property to its owner
actionTypes.credit_escheat_remit: Remit unclaimed property to the authority
actionTypes.credit_fx_reference_rate_entry: Enter an official exchange rate by hand

adminLicence.fxManualTitle: Enter an official rate by hand
adminLicence.fxManualDetail: Use this only when the central bank page cannot be read. Copy the published figure and say where you read it. A different admin must approve it before it is used.
adminLicence.fxManualBadCurrency: Enter a 3-letter currency code other than USD.
adminLicence.fxManualBadRate: Enter a positive rate, for example 131.25.
adminLicence.fxManualBadDate: Choose the date the rate was published for.
adminLicence.fxManualBadNote: Say where you read the figure (at least 5 characters).
adminLicence.sarAmountMinor: Amount (in cents or the smallest unit)
adminLicence.sarBadAmount: Enter the amount as a whole number of the smallest unit.
adminLicence.sarBadCurrency: Enter a 3-letter currency code, for example HTG.
adminLicence.sarBadRange: The start date must be on or before the end date.
adminLicence.anchorDetailHelp: This is the exact content whose fingerprint was sent outside OxSteed that day. Compare the fingerprint with the emailed or stored copy.
